title: Frozen Rockmelon Protein Shake
description: Creamy frozen rockmelon smoothie with homemade Greek yogurt, skim milk powder, chia and ground flax. No protein powder or ice needed.

ingredients.name: cold water
ingredients.note: start here; add up to 50 g more if needed

steps.text: Add the frozen rockmelon, Greek yogurt, skim milk powder, chia, ground flaxseed, and 50 g cold water to a blender.
Blend for 20–30 seconds until creamy. If it's too thick, add a splash more cold water (up to about 50 g extra) and blend again.
Pour into a glass and drink immediately. No ice needed.

notes: Freeze rockmelon cubes ahead of time. Frozen fruit makes the shake cold and thick without ice.
Start with 50 g water; use up to 100 g in total to adjust thickness. Nutrition per 100 g assumes 50 g added water and a 375 g finished shake.
Optional: a squeeze of lime, not included in nutrition.
Nutrition is an estimate using 122 kcal per 100 g for the homemade fortified Greek yogurt. Actual values depend on the yogurt and milk powder.
